The Warped Point demo is now available on Steam, completely free to play.You can finally step into this world and discover for the first time what I've been working on all this time. Explore the unknown, master your weapons, and face the dangers that await you in the Void.I want to thank everyone who has shown interest in the project, followed its development, and helped it reach this point. events.title: The Warped Point demo is finally here!
events.summary: Yes, it's happening.After talking about a possible demo for so long, I can finally announce that the Warped Point demo will be available to play this Friday, October 9th.It's been a long journey, and there's still a lot left to do, but this is the first step towards letting you experience the world I've been building for so long.

events.title: Warped Point's First Trailer
events.summary: After a long wait, we can finally show you the first official trailer for the game. This trailer showcases the upcoming free DEMO of Warped Point, so it doesn't represent the full content of the final game, but it does feature its core mechanics and the essence of the experience.I hope you enjoy it!

events.title: Development Update #3 - Combat Showcase
events.summary: Welcome to the third official Warped Point development post.This time, I won't be explaining too much, because the video speaks for itself.Today I want to showcase the potential of Warped Point and its combat system. For the first time, you'll get to see raw gameplay footage, including fights against regular enemies and a preview of the game's first boss.Everything you'll see is still a work in progress.
